## Summary

Describe the problem and the solution in a few sentences.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Database / migration

## Validation

List the commands and manual flows you ran.

```text
npm run lint
npx tsc --noEmit
npm run test:security-hardening
npm run build
```

## UI changes

If this changes visible UI, add before/after screenshots for desktop and mobile where relevant. Remove personal data before uploading images.

## Security and data impact

- [ ] I reviewed authentication and authorization implications.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, credentials or real student data.
- [ ] New or changed inputs are validated appropriately.
- [ ] Database changes include a versioned migration when required.
- [ ] Logs and error messages do not expose sensitive information.

## Final checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactors.
- [ ] Relevant documentation was updated.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests were added or updated.
- [ ] I tested the affected user flow manually when applicable.
